candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Noise-calibrated promotion gate with fresh-seed certification and interaction-aware edit attribution
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: Agentic AutoResearch separates fast search from a credibility audit. Rendezvous seed noise was 4.04 +/- 0.26 m over 10 seeds; the audited candidate reached 0.101 +/- 0.007 m over 10 fresh seeds with perfect success and about a 15 sigma margin. Docking seed noise was 8.45 +/- 1.55; the audited candidate reached 0.38 +/- 0.07 over 10 fresh seeds, 10/10 strict-feasible, about a 5.2 sigma margin. The audit performs leave-one-out edit pruning. In rendezvous, five edits were individually load-bearing while four individually null edits jointly mattered: reverting the four together regressed the metric from 0.101 to 0.192, demonstrating interaction effects that pure leave-one-out can miss.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: Let inner scientific search be optimistic, but promote a result only after fresh disjoint-seed evaluation, effect-size normalization by measured baseline noise, and hard-constraint checks. Attribute edits with leave-one-out only as a first pass; add coalition or interaction checks before discarding individually null changes.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Two aerospace behavioral-cloning problem families, one agent campaign per family, one main model backend. The paper notes its random-search arm used a smaller training-budget range than the winning LLM configuration, so the evidence supports the promotion/audit mechanism more strongly than a universal LLM-search advantage. Run-to-run variance of the research agent itself is not characterized.

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Trajectory-to-evidence conversion with isolated artifact verification, best-round retention, claim qualification, and explicit applicability boundaries
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: From Trajectories to Evidence reports 30 paper-to-target adaptations: 26/30 had a later valid round outperform the first, but 22/30 ended with the final round worse than an earlier best, directly arguing against treating final trajectory state as the knowledge record. With the same GLM-5.2 model in context-isolated generate-verify-repair, proposal-gate acceptance rose 73.3% to 100%, code completeness 92% to 97%, observability 67% to 100%, while alignment changed only 50% to 52%. Post-hoc audit reduced 14 candidate claims to 8 Repair, 1 Guard, and 5 Withheld; all 34 referenced artifacts matched archived SHA-256. A downstream controller on 64 frozen target-record pairs made only four Apply decisions and only one was correct: 25% affirmative precision; overall accuracy 67.2%, below an always-Reject 79.7% baseline on the imbalanced set.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: Convert trajectories into qualified evidence records instead of storing transcripts or final endpoints. Preserve validated best intermediate interventions, verify artifacts in isolated contexts, withhold confounded claims, and treat record application to a new target as a hypothesis requiring execution rather than confirmation of transfer.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Industrial recommender adaptations with GLM-5.2. Same-model isolation can retain correlated blind spots. Reported online lifts (+0.75% live-page duration and +6.34% user-growth net utility) are selected-candidate outcomes against frozen baselines, not a clean framework-level causal estimate; there is no parallel plain-agent/no-memory production arm.

candidate_mechanisms_new.mechanism: Semantic verification cascade plus bounded multi-candidate search and failure-to-forbidden-direction memory for architecture transfer
candidate_mechanisms_new.evidence: NOVA reports a same-budget L3 Literature-to-Production component study. Full NOVA: logical-pass rate 86.7%, silent-failure rate 30.8%, effective-pass rate 60.0%. Removing Paper Reproduction changes these to 91.7/63.6/33.3; removing Solution Design to 81.8/77.8/18.2; removing Multi-Candidate Generation to 66.7/61.1/25.9; removing Quality Assessment to 71.9/69.6/21.9; removing Architecture-Gradient Feedback to 87.5/57.1/37.5. The pattern shows that runnability alone can improve while semantic validity collapses, and that diagnostics converted into reusable forbidden modification directions add value beyond final-metric observation. The paper also reports production A/B GMV lifts of +1.25%, +1.70%, and +2.02% for selected variants with substantial pCVR-bias reductions.
candidate_mechanisms_new.interpretation: For architecture-transfer research, validate semantics before ranking runnable candidates; generate a bounded candidate set, quality-gate survivors, and transform diagnosed failures into explicit forbidden or down-weighted future directions. Optimize effective semantic pass rate, not executable-code rate alone.
candidate_mechanisms_new.scope: Industrial recommender architecture transfer and internal production infrastructure. The L3 component ablations provide strong within-system evidence but do not isolate every interaction or prove transfer to general scientific discovery. Online A/B results support selected candidate quality, not full-framework causality.

negative_and_boundary_evidence_new: Agentic AutoResearch's random-versus-LLM search comparison is not a clean causal estimate of search strategy because the random arm sampled a smaller training-budget range than the winning LLM configuration. Preserve the fresh-seed credibility gate as the stronger result.
Fresh-seed certification of the selected candidate does not characterize variance across independent research-agent campaigns; one campaign per task family remains a reproducibility gap.
Leave-one-out attribution can miss coalitional effects: in the rendezvous study, four individually null edits jointly changed the audited metric materially when reverted together.

Context-isolated verification with the same base model strongly improved proposal acceptance, completeness and observability in From Trajectories to Evidence, but code alignment changed only 50% to 52%; isolation is not equivalent to independent verification and may preserve shared blind spots.

From Trajectories to Evidence's downstream reuse controller had only 25% affirmative precision. Stored evidence should not be auto-applied to a new target; Apply should trigger a target-local experiment.
The two reported production lifts in From Trajectories to Evidence are candidate-level outcomes, not a framework-level randomized ablation.

NOVA shows that logical pass rate can rise while silent semantic failure worsens: removing paper reproduction produced higher runnability but much worse silent-failure/effective-pass rates. Executability is an unsafe optimization target by itself.
NOVA's production A/B evidence is selected-candidate evidence in recommender systems, not proof that the full harness or its memory mechanism transfers to other sciences.
